name: Volume Preparation & Canonical Resampling
definition: Converts a source volume to a canonical NIfTI format, downsamples to a maximum dimension of 320, computes display range via percentiles, and saves to an immutable cache.
summary: Volume Preparation & Canonical Resampling converts medical volumes to a standardized NIfTI format with geometric normalization and display-range calculation, differing from other pipelines by focusing on these specific steps rather than segmentation or video extraction.
